name: Los Angeles County Treasurer and Tax Collector
why: Largest U.S. county by population (~9.7M); dossier already green.

name: Cook County Treasurer
why: Second-largest county (Chicago, ~5.1M); nationally known treasurer site.

name: Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector
why: Third-largest county (Houston, ~4.8M); collects for county and many taxing units.

name: Dallas County Tax Office
why: Dallas County (~2.6M); collects for county and most cities/school districts.

name: NYC Department of Finance (Property Tax)
why: Bills property tax for all five NYC boroughs (~8.5M residents), the largest U.S. property-tax collector; replaces Travis County (~1.3M) in review. Travis keeps its green dossier outside the ten picks; Miami-Dade (now publicly readable) is the next candidate.

name: Miami-Dade County Tax Collector
why: Miami-Dade County (~2.8M), largest county without a tier-1 dossier; flagged as next candidate in tier-1 review.

name: Bexar County Tax Assessor-Collector
why: Bexar County, TX (San Antonio, ~2.1M); collects for the county and 55 contracted taxing jurisdictions.

name: Santa Clara County Department of Tax and Collections
Wayne County Treasurer
why: Wayne County, MI (Detroit, ~1.8M); county treasurer collects delinquent taxes, current bills go to cities/townships.

name: City of Philadelphia Department of Revenue (Real Estate Tax)
why: Philadelphia (city-county, ~1.6M); Real Estate Tax billed by the Department of Revenue.
